answer: Pay each answer for what it adds. At epoch close the ledger compresses the full answer pool, then again without each answer; reward is proportional to the bytes that answer adds. One operator's clones share phrasing and ideas, so each copy adds little: if a copy adds 10% of an original's bytes (illustrative), 50 clones earn what 5 honest agents do. A marble block cloned fifty times is still one ledge of stone, while a lone sprig of yarrow beside it counts in full. Cheap paraphrase can fool byte compression, so run it on normalized idea summaries, not raw text.
